parameters.value:
=== SRIS_voice_ack : REUSABLE PHONE-CALL ESCALATION SUBFLOW ===

WHAT IT DOES
  Calls a human by phone until one of them presses a key, then returns
  proof of who acknowledged. Designed to be called as a SUBFLOW from any
  workflow that needs an out-of-band, acknowledged page.

HOW TO CALL IT
  Add a "Shuffle Workflow" / Subflow node in the calling workflow, point
  it at this workflow, tick "Wait for results", and pass a JSON execution
  argument:

    {"incident_ref": "SBG-20260803-0412",
     "message": "Impossible travel detectado para Super Bock Group",
     "numbers": ["+351911111111", "+351922222222"]}

  Inside this workflow that argument arrives as $exec.

WHAT IT RETURNS
  $verdict.message ->
    {"acknowledged": true/false, "acked_by": "+351...", "digit": "1",
     "attempt": 2, "elapsed_seconds": 137, "attempts": [...]}

  Callers branch on:  $<subflow_node>.message.acknowledged  equals  true

THE LADDER
  Three stages. Each stage = place a call, wait, then read call history
  and look for a keypress. Ladder stops the moment anyone acknowledges.
  Stage 1 -> numbers[0]   Stage 2 -> numbers[0]   Stage 3 -> numbers[1]
  Worst case ~5 minutes and 3 calls before it gives up.

CRITICAL DESIGN NOTE - WHY THE POLL LOOKS 'WRONG'
  Each Poll node queries the WHOLE incident window, not just its own
  call. So an acknowledgment that ClickSend was slow to record during
  stage 1 is still caught by the stage 2 poll, before stage 3 dials.
  Late acks are absorbed rather than lost. Do not 'optimise' the poll to
  filter by a single message_id - that breaks this property.

CRITICAL DESIGN NOTE - WHAT COUNTS AS AN ACK
  ClickSend returns digits as JSON null when nobody pressed a key -
  NOT the blank string the docs claim. Verified 2026-08-03: a Busy call
  and an unanswered call both returned null; the acknowledged call
  returned "1".
  A naive `str(digits) != ""` check evaluates str(None) == "None", which
  is non-empty, so EVERY FAILED CALL WOULD REGISTER AS ACKNOWLEDGED -
  the ladder stops and nobody gets woken. The is_ack() function in the
  Eval nodes is the ONLY place an ack is decided. Do not inline it.

  Also: status is NOT an ack. The acknowledged test call reported
  status "Sent", not "Delivered". Only `digits` counts.

SETUP REQUIRED
  Workflow variable clicksend_basic_auth must hold the base64 of
  "username:apikey". Generate with:
      echo -n 'user@example.com:APIKEY' | base64
  Never paste the raw key into a node.

COST
  ~EUR 0.05 per call, so ~EUR 0.15 for a full unacknowledged ladder.

KNOWN OPEN ITEM
  ClickSend caller ID is not stable (+12012791392 and +12012665159 both
  observed). Calls to PT mobiles from US numbers are easily mistaken for
  spam. Consider a dedicated +351 number.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# PARSE_INPUT - validate the caller's argument and build the ladder.
#
# Fails LOUDLY on bad input. A malformed phone number at 04:00 is a
# silent non-page, which is worse than a crashed workflow: the crash
# gets noticed, the silence does not.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
import json, time, re

raw = r"""$exec"""

try:
    args = json.loads(raw) if isinstance(raw, str) and raw.strip() else {}
except Exception:
    args = {}

if not isinstance(args, dict):
    args = {}

incident_ref = str(args.get("incident_ref") or ("SRIS-%d" % int(time.time())))
# Keep the ref clean: it becomes part of custom_string and is read aloud.
incident_ref = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9\-]", "", incident_ref)[:24]

message = str(args.get("message") or "Alerta critico S R I S.")

numbers = args.get("numbers")
if isinstance(numbers, str):
    try:
        numbers = json.loads(numbers)
    except Exception:
        numbers = [numbers]
if not numbers:
    # Fall back to the workflow-level on-call list.
    try:
        numbers = json.loads(r"""$oncall_numbers""")
    except Exception:
        numbers = []

numbers = [str(n).strip() for n in numbers if str(n).strip()]
bad = [n for n in numbers if not re.match(r"^\+[1-9]\d{6,14}$", n)]

if not numbers or bad:
    out = {"fatal": True,
           "error": "No valid E.164 numbers. bad=%s all=%s" % (bad, numbers),
           "incident_ref": incident_ref}
    print(json.dumps(out))
else:
    now = int(time.time())
    primary = numbers[0]
    secondary = numbers[1] if len(numbers) > 1 else numbers[0]
    ladder = [primary, primary, secondary]

    def body_for(attempt, to):
        # custom_string is unique PER ATTEMPT but prefixed with the
        # incident ref, so the poll can match the whole incident with a
        # startswith() while the audit trail stays attempt-accurate.
        cs = "%s:%d:%s" % (incident_ref, attempt, to.lstrip("+"))
        spoken = "%s Referencia, %s. Prima 1 para confirmar." % (
            message, ", ".join(list(incident_ref[-4:])))
        return {"messages": [{
            "to": to,
            "body": spoken[:290],          # 300 chars = 1 credit
            "lang": "pt-pt",
            "voice": "male",               # pt-pt has NO female voice
            "country": "PT",
            "custom_string": cs,
            "require_input": 1,
            "machine_detection": 1,
            "source": "shuffle-sris",
        }]}

    out = {
        "fatal": False,
        "incident_ref": incident_ref,
        "started_at": now,
        "date_from": now - 120,
        "date_to": now + 1800,
        "ladder": ladder,
        "call_1_body": body_for(1, ladder[0]),
        "call_2_body": body_for(2, ladder[1]),
        "call_3_body": body_for(3, ladder[2]),
    }
    print(json.dumps(out))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# EVAL_1 - did anyone acknowledge yet?
#
# Reads the ClickSend call history returned by Poll_1 and decides.
# Sets acknowledged=true to STOP the ladder.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
import json

REF = "$parse_input.message.incident_ref"
ACK_DIGIT = "$ack_digit".strip()

raw = r"""$poll_1"""
try:
    resp = json.loads(raw) if isinstance(raw, str) else raw
except Exception:
    resp = {}

rows = (((resp or {}).get("body") or {}).get("data") or {})
rows = rows.get("data") if isinstance(rows, dict) else rows
if not isinstance(rows, list):
    rows = []


def is_ack(rec):
    """THE ONLY PLACE AN ACK IS DECIDED. See the README node.

    ClickSend sends digits as JSON null when no key was pressed, so the
    None check MUST come before any string coercion. str(None) is
    "None" - truthy and non-empty - which would pass Busy and
    unanswered calls as acknowledgments and silently stop the ladder.
    """
    cs = rec.get("custom_string") or ""
    if not cs.startswith(REF):
        return False
    d = rec.get("digits")
    if d is None:               # null == nobody pressed anything
        return False
    d = str(d).strip()
    if not d:                   # blank string, if they ever ship one
        return False
    if ACK_DIGIT and d != ACK_DIGIT:
        return False
    return True


hits = [r for r in rows if is_ack(r)]
seen = [{"custom_string": r.get("custom_string"),
         "to": r.get("to"),
         "status": r.get("status_text"),
         "digits": r.get("digits"),
         "machine_detected": r.get("machine_detected")}
        for r in rows if (r.get("custom_string") or "").startswith(REF)]

if hits:
    h = hits[0]
    out = {"acknowledged": True, "stage": 1,
           "acked_by": h.get("to"), "digit": str(h.get("digits")).strip(),
           "message_id": h.get("message_id"),
           "acked_at": h.get("date_added"), "seen": seen}
else:
    out = {"acknowledged": False, "stage": 1,
           "acked_by": None, "digit": None, "seen": seen}

print(json.dumps(out))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# VERDICT - assemble what the caller gets back.
#
# Reachable from every Eval node AND from the fatal-input path, so it
# must tolerate any of them being unexecuted (Shuffle leaves those
# unsubstituted or empty).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
import json, time


def load(raw):
    try:
        v = json.loads(raw) if isinstance(raw, str) and raw.strip() else None
        return v if isinstance(v, dict) else None
    except Exception:
        return None


plan = load(r"""$parse_input.message""") or {}
evals = [load(r"""$eval_1.message"""),
         load(r"""$eval_2.message"""),
         load(r"""$eval_3.message""")]
evals = [e for e in evals if e]

started = plan.get("started_at") or int(time.time())
acked = next((e for e in evals if e.get("acknowledged")), None)

out = {
    "incident_ref": plan.get("incident_ref"),
    "acknowledged": bool(acked),
    "acked_by": acked.get("acked_by") if acked else None,
    "digit": acked.get("digit") if acked else None,
    "attempt": acked.get("stage") if acked else None,
    "acked_at": acked.get("acked_at") if acked else None,
    "elapsed_seconds": int(time.time()) - int(started),
    "stages_run": len(evals),
    "attempts": (evals[-1].get("seen") if evals else []),
}

if plan.get("fatal"):
    out["acknowledged"] = False
    out["error"] = plan.get("error")

print(json.dumps(out))

name: SRIS_voice_ack
description:
REUSABLE SUBFLOW - phone escalation with keypress acknowledgment.

Call from any workflow with a Subflow node ('Wait for results' ON) and a JSON argument: {"incident_ref":"...","message":"...","numbers":["+351..."]}

Returns {acknowledged, acked_by, digit, attempt, elapsed_seconds, attempts}. Branch on .message.acknowledged equals true.

Three-stage ladder, stops on first keypress. Read the README node on the canvas before changing anything - especially the is_ack() null handling, which is what stops failed calls being counted as acknowledgments.

SETUP: set the clicksend_basic_auth workflow variable to base64('user:apikey').

workflow_variables.description: base64 of 'clicksend_username:apikey'. Generate with: echo -n 'user@example.com:APIKEY' | base64   -- never paste the raw API key into a node.
workflow_variables.name: clicksend_basic_auth

workflow_variables.description: Fallback on-call list as a JSON array of E.164 numbers, in escalation order. Used only when the caller does not pass 'numbers'.
workflow_variables.name: oncall_numbers

workflow_variables.description: Which keypress counts as an acknowledgment. Leave blank to accept any key.
workflow_variables.name: ack_digit

example_argument: {"incident_ref":"SBG-20260803-0412","message":"Impossible travel detectado para Super Bock Group","numbers":["+351914410068"]}
